- [stated] wants to start making AI-generated story videos for TikTok (inspired by the trend); chose the mini-series format [s:4b8636c7f323b727]
- [stated] going with the mystery concept «3:33» (guy in a cheap flat gets videos of himself sleeping at 3:33) [s:4b8636c7f323b727]

- [stated] also plans to publish the series on YouTube (Shorts) [s:4b8636c7f323b727]
- [stated] created YouTube channel «scary.stories» (@scary.stories-f5w) for it; uses ElevenLabs for voiceover; took an ad deal to place a VPN banner (t.me/fahevpn) in videos with the link in the profile [s:4b8636c7f323b727]
- [stated] published episode 1 on YouTube Shorts (16 Nov 2026) and is posting it to TikTok too; wants to add in-between «что будет, если…» style videos alongside the series [s:4b8636c7f323b727]
- [stated] found the ggsel/PROMIQO creator offer; plans to run ggsel integrations on YouTube Shorts and keep the VPN ad on TikTok [s:4b8636c7f323b727]
- [stated] wants to make a new, fun/entertaining (possibly science-themed) AI series alongside «3:33», with episodes ~40–50 sec (Nov 2026); going with «Сжатый» (student shrinks to ant size), generates the realistic images himself [s:4f68d27e4483f83d]
- [stated] working with the Pringles VPN ad offer (pay per 10k views; banner must be chroma-keyed, centered, placed at the video's midpoint); put its banner into «Сжатый» episode 1 [s:4f68d27e4483f83d]
